name: Viridescent-Drumlin
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by an ancient meteor crater. Farther poleward, past towering mountain ranges, the silence feels older than the soil.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
the ancient alien ruins still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
The artifact market prices fragments from this world like scripture. Provenance papers are forged in three systems, badly.
